_comment: Week 6 eval set (W6-Task-Set-C.md). `mode` values are PLACEHOLDER failure-mode names -- Week 5's taxonomy.md (notes.md -> open coding -> named modes) has not been produced yet in this repo, so these are provisional groupings inferred from this app's own documented behavior (IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRESS.md) and real trace data (see scripts/extract_regression_candidates.py), not the graded Week-5 deliverable. Replace every 'mode' value with your real taxonomy.md mode names once that exists. The 2 entries with id starting 'w6-regression-' are intentionally unfilled -- run scripts/extract_regression_candidates.py, pick 2 real trace_ids you'd call a genuine regression, and fill in 'question' (and optionally 'source_trace_id') by hand. `checks` names 0+ keys from evals/assertions.py::ASSERTIONS (deterministic, no LLM); `judge_graded` (true for every case here, per the rubric's single-binary-criterion judge) means the harness also runs the judge and records its verdict for the labeling/agreement steps in scripts/label_answers.py and scripts/measure_judge_agreement.py.
